description_en: Queries the information about a specified basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用GetBasicAccelerator接口查询指定的基础型全球加速实例的信息
kebab_example: aliyun ga get-basic-accelerator --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp17frjjh0udz4qz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetBasicAccelerator

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的基础型全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id

AcceleratorId.description_en: The ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance

BandwidthBillingType.description_en:
The billing method for bandwidth. Valid values:
BandwidthPackage: billed by bandwidth plan.
CDT: billed by traffic and settled through Cloud Data Transfer (CDT).
CDT95: billed by the 95th percentile bandwidth and settled through CDT. This billing method is available only for users in the whitelist
BandwidthBillingType.description_zh:
带宽计费方式。
BandwidthPackage：按带宽包计费。
CDT：按流量计费并由云数据传输（Cloud DataTransfer，简称CDT）统一结算。
CDT95：按95计费并由CDT统一结算。该带宽计费方式仅白名单用户可用

BasicBandwidthPackage.description_en: The details of the basic bandwidth plan associated with the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
BasicBandwidthPackage.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例绑定的基础带宽包的详情

Bandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth value of the basic bandwidth plan. Unit: Mbit/s
Bandwidth.description_zh: 基础带宽包的带宽值。单位：Mbps

BandwidthType.description_en:
The bandwidth type of the basic bandwidth plan. Valid values:

Basic: standard acceleration bandwidth.

Enhanced: enhanced acceleration bandwidth.

Advanced: premium acceleration bandwidth
BandwidthType.description_zh:
基础带宽包的带宽类型。

Basic：标准加速带宽。

Enhanced：增强加速带宽。

Advanced：精品加速带宽

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the basic bandwidth plan

BasicEndpointGroupId.description_en: The endpoint group ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
BasicEndpointGroupId.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的终端节点组ID

BasicIpSetId.description_en: The acceleration region ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
BasicIpSetId.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的加速地域ID

CenId.description_en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance associated with the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
CenId.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例绑定的云企业网实例ID

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例创建时间戳
CreateTime.title_zh: 全球加速实例创建时间

CrossBorderStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the cross-border line feature is enabled for the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Valid values:

true: The cross-border line feature is enabled and cross-border acceleration is supported.

false: The cross-border line feature is disabled and cross-border acceleration is not supported
CrossBorderStatus.description_zh:
基础型全球加速实例是否开启跨境线路功能。取值：

true：开启跨境线路功能，支持加速跨境线路。

false：关闭跨境线路功能，不支持加速跨境线路

CrossDomainBandwidthPackage.description_en:
The details of the cross-border acceleration bandwidth plan associated with the Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

This array is returned only on the Chinese site (Chinese mainland regions) or the international site (regions outside the Chinese mainland)
CrossDomainBandwidthPackage.description_zh:
全球加速实例绑定的跨地域加速包的详情。

仅国际站支持返回该数组

Bandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth value of the cross-border acceleration bandwidth plan. Unit: Mbit/s
Bandwidth.description_zh: 跨地域加速带宽包的带宽值。单位：Mbps

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the cross-border acceleration bandwidth plan
InstanceId.description_zh: 跨地域加速带宽包的实例ID

CrossPrivateState.description_en:
Indicates whether cross-border bandwidth is enabled for the cross-region bandwidth. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false: disabled
CrossPrivateState.description_zh:
是否开启了跨地域带宽跨境。

true：是。

false：否

Description.description_en: The description of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
Description.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的描述信息

ExpiredTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance expires.

The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds, representing the number of seconds elapsed since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC
ExpiredTime.description_zh:
基础型全球加速实例到期时间戳。

Unix时间戳格式，单位为秒，表示从1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数

InstanceChargeType.description_en: The billing method of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Only PREPAY (subscription) is returned
InstanceChargeType.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例计费方式。仅支持返回PREPAY（包年包月）
InstanceChargeType.title_zh: 全球加速实例收费类型

Name.description_en: The name of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
Name.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例名称

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
RegionId.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例所属的地域ID

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance belongs
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例所属资源组ID

State.description_en:
The status of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Valid values:
init: being initialized.

active: available.

configuring: being configured.

binding: being associated.

unbinding: being disassociated.

deleting: being deleted.

finacialLocked: locked due to overdue payment
State.description_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的状态。
init：初始化。

active：可用。

configuring：配置中。

binding：绑定中。

unbinding：解绑中。

deleting：删除中。

finacialLocked：欠费锁定

Tags.description_en: The tags of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
Tags.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的标签

items.description_en: The tags of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
items.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的标签

Key.description_en: The tag key of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
Key.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的标签键

Value.description_en: The tag value of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
Value.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的标签值
